name: Gina
source: Her personality is lively and proactive. She can also feel a bit too simplistic at times. She serves as a leader figure among the apprentice mages at the Youd Magic Academy. Although she acts tough on the outside, deep down she has a desire to be pampered by a reliable man. She prefers flashy and offensive magic.
